guides.conceptEn: Verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：水庫排砂隧道
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels
guides.concept: 本課以以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道為主線，先用分流比與庫區水量與懸砂質量通量界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降與行程時間、底板磨耗與厚度連結到水砂守恆與稽核。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection through Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow and Suspended sediment mass flux, then connects Settling and transit time and Invert abrasion and thickness to Water sediment conservation audit. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
procedure: 繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。水量分流比不等於泥砂分流比，因垂向與橫向濃度可能不均；應同時量測分流前後水量、懸砂與粗粒，避免只以閘門開度推估成效。 驗證時應同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流，並辨識以下失效情境：只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
懸浮泥砂通量由水量與代表性質量濃度相乘，採樣點是否代表整個斷面是關鍵。濁度需現地率定，粗顆粒可能以掃流通過而不在水樣中；質量帳應明確區分懸砂與床載，不能把單一表層水樣當全部輸砂。 驗證時應以斷面積分採樣比對濁度率定並另記粗粒輸送，並辨識以下失效情境：表層低濃度水樣會漏估近床高濃度泥砂。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
繞庫成效應按洪水事件積分輸砂質量，再與同事件進砂相比。只取峰值濃度乘總水量可能偏差很大，因濃度峰與流量峰未必同步；事件前後暫存砂量也應列入，才能區分真正繞庫與短期堆積。 驗證時應以同時間窗積分各支流水砂通量並調查分流前池淤積，並辨識以下失效情境：漏算分流前池暫存會把滯留砂誤當成功繞庫。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
排砂隧道常需高速輸送以減少沉積，但自由水面與滿流邊界必須明確區分。平均速度由有效水深與寬度求得，不能用整個開挖截面代替通水面積；沿程含氣、彎道與頂部餘裕也會影響輸送穩定。 驗證時應核對沿程水深速度與含氣厚度並確認未碰頂滿流，並辨識以下失效情境：誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。靜水沉降距離只示範兩種時間尺度，不能預測高速隧道的實際沉積；仍需粒徑分級及近床濃度觀測。 驗證時應比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。示意希爾茲數不能直接指定一個普遍啟動門檻；應以現地粒料與適用實驗比較，並分辨掃流與懸浮。 驗證時應核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
粗粒高速接觸底板會產生磨耗，其分布與流束集中、彎道及施工接縫有關。兩次測量差除以期間只給過去平均耗損率，不能自動預報未來壽命；材料改變、事件強度與裸露鋼筋都可能使速率改變。 驗證時應用固定基準重測磨耗圖並按流量與粒徑分組運轉時數，並辨識以下失效情境：用低含砂年度平均率外推高含砂洪水會低估損傷。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
繞庫出口把含砂水重新接入河道，混合濃度需按水量加權而非兩濃度平均。完全混合假設通常只在足夠距離後合理，近岸高濃度帶與沉降可能主導局部影響；需量測橫斷面與事件持續時間。 驗證時應沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化，並辨識以下失效情境：立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
洪水的含砂峰可能早於或晚於水量峰，分流時機決定可攔截的砂量與所用水量。用分段質量積分比較時窗能示範取捨，但不構成即時操作指令；實際調度還需洪水安全、下游限制與設備狀態共同核准。 驗證時應對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，並辨識以下失效情境：以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
完整排砂評估應讓進砂、出砂與庫內暫存閉合，並將量測不確定度與未量床載分開列出。殘差不是自動等於未量侵蝕，採樣偏差與測深基準也可能造成差額；需要以獨立地形與質量觀測交叉核算。 驗證時應用獨立測深與乾密度估算庫存變化再比對通量帳，並辨識以下失效情境：把所有殘差都歸於侵蝕會掩蓋採樣或密度錯誤。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
procedureEn: A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream. Water diversion fraction is not sediment diversion fraction because concentration varies vertically and laterally. Measure water, suspended sediment and coarse material on both branches rather than inferring performance solely from gate position. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Suspended flux equals discharge times representative mass concentration. Sampling must represent the section and turbidity needs local calibration. Coarse bed load may pass outside the water samples, so distinguish suspended and bed-load budgets instead of treating a single surface sample as total transport. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check turbidity against cross-section sampling and document coarse transport separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A dilute surface sample underestimates concentrated near-bed sediment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Evaluate bypass efficiency from event-integrated sediment mass relative to the same incoming event. Peak concentration times total water can be biased because peaks need not coincide. Include temporary storage changes to distinguish successful bypass from sediment merely retained near the intake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate branch fluxes over one window and survey intake-pool storage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring intake-pool storage misclassifies retained sediment as successful bypass. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

High-speed conveyance can reduce deposition, but free-surface and pressurized boundaries must be distinguished. Calculate mean velocity from actual wetted area rather than the excavated section. Aeration, bends and clearance above the flow also affect stable sediment transport and require separate checks. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check depth, velocity and aerated thickness along the tunnel and confirm free-surface clearance. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment. A still-water settling distance compares time scales but does not predict deposition in a turbulent bypass tunnel. Size fractions and near-bed observations remain necessary to establish transport behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight. Roughness, hiding, slope and gradation alter the critical value, so an illustrative number does not establish a universal entrainment threshold. Compare representative sediment with suitable experiments and distinguish bed load from suspension. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

High-speed coarse particles abrade the invert, especially where jets, bends or joints concentrate contact. Survey difference divided by elapsed exposure gives a past average, not a future life prediction. Material changes, event intensity and reinforcement exposure can alter the rate after the observation period. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Repeat abrasion surveys on a fixed datum and group exposure by discharge and grain size. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extrapolating a low-sediment average into a coarse flood understates damage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

The outlet reconnects sediment-laden water to the river. Mixed concentration requires discharge weighting, not a simple concentration average. Complete mixing may occur only farther downstream, while near-bank plumes and settling govern local exposure; measure cross-sections and event duration instead of assuming immediate uniformity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Sediment peaks can precede or follow discharge peaks, making diversion timing important. Piecewise mass integration compares windows and water use but is not a real-time operating instruction. Actual decisions combine flood safety, downstream constraints and equipment state through the approved operating framework. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

A complete assessment reconciles incoming, outgoing and stored sediment while separating uncertainty and unmeasured bed load. A residual is not automatically erosion; sampling bias and survey datums can also create imbalance. Cross-check mass records against independent bed surveys and consistent dry-density assumptions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Estimate storage change from independent bathymetry and dry density and compare flux records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning every residual to erosion conceals sampling or density errors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
evidence: 交接時以同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以以斷面積分採樣比對濁度率定並另記粗粒輸送作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對表層低濃度水樣會漏估近床高濃度泥砂，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以以同時間窗積分各支流水砂通量並調查分流前池淤積作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏算分流前池暫存會把滯留砂誤當成功繞庫，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以核對沿程水深速度與含氣厚度並確認未碰頂滿流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
evidenceEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check turbidity against cross-section sampling and document coarse transport separately. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A dilute surface sample underestimates concentrated near-bed sediment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Integrate branch fluxes over one window and survey intake-pool storage. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring intake-pool storage misclassifies retained sediment as successful bypass. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check depth, velocity and aerated thickness along the tunnel and confirm free-surface clearance. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
pitfalls: 只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
漏算分流前池暫存會把滯留砂誤當成功繞庫。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時間窗積分各支流水砂通量並調查分流前池淤積，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
用低含砂年度平均率外推高含砂洪水會低估損傷。診斷時應採取以下查核：用固定基準重測磨耗圖並按流量與粒徑分組運轉時數，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。診斷時應採取以下查核：對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
pitfallsEn: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Ignoring intake-pool storage misclassifies retained sediment as successful bypass. Diagnose it by the following check: Integrate branch fluxes over one window and survey intake-pool storage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Extrapolating a low-sediment average into a coarse flood understates damage. Diagnose it by the following check: Repeat abrasion surveys on a fixed datum and group exposure by discharge and grain size. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. Diagnose it by the following check: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水庫異重流排砂
related.transfer: 可遷移「分流比與庫區水量」與「底板磨耗與厚度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水庫異重流排砂的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow" and "Invert abrasion and thickness" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Density-current venting for reservoir sediment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道；水庫異重流排砂則以以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection; Density-current venting for reservoir sediment centres on analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分流比與庫區水量」與「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水庫異重流排砂，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「底孔捕捉與排出」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow” and “Suspension concentration and mixture density”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Density-current venting for reservoir sediment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Low-outlet capture and export", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 水庫排砂隧道
history.text: 本課所研究的以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
